description: Every tool the Dimensaz agent can use. status: ready | planned. Planned tools must not be promised as available.

tools.description: First-run setup: language, brand profile, .env and tool check.
tools.whenToUse: Once per machine, or when the user wants to change language or brand.

tools.description: Check Node, FFmpeg, FFprobe, Chromium, fonts and optional audio tools.
tools.whenToUse: Before the first job, and whenever rendering fails unexpectedly.

tools.description: Check the optional local audio pipeline.
tools.whenToUse: Before using automatic Sorani word alignment.

tools.description: Install the local audio pipeline into .venv (asks before large downloads).
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user approves local speech analysis.

tools.description: Start a guided brief from a script; returns the missing questions.
tools.whenToUse: Mode A/B when the request is incomplete.

tools.description: Record answers to briefing questions.
tools.whenToUse: After the user answers questions.

tools.description: Turn a completed brief into a production request.
tools.whenToUse: When every needed answer is known.

tools.description: Finish a conversational job.
tools.whenToUse: After approval of a conversational job.

tools.description: Interactive style director: palette, grid, typography, motion, sound choices.
tools.whenToUse: When the user wants fine control over a design direction.

tools.description: Pick an explainer theme from a semantic brief, avoiding recent repeats.
tools.whenToUse: Script explainers.

tools.description: Automatic storyboard: splits a script into one sentence per scene, reads each sentence's meaning (problem, product reveal, tasks, tracking, growth, a number, speed, support, team, steps, call to action), picks an animated scene piece filled from the sentence's own words and numbers, uses the brain's genre recipe (device, order, transitions) and writes request.json plus storyboard.md listing every guessed detail for the user to check. English and Kurdish.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz storyboard SCRIPT.txt|--text "..." [--product NAME] [--genre auto|saas-promo|app-launch|explainer|product-ad|tutorial] [--device phone|browser] [--people "A,B"] [--format 9:16] [--out DIR]
tools.whenToUse: Before every new script video: draft the storyboard, get approval, then video:create.

tools.description: Animated, brand-coloured scene pieces for video:create requests: phone and browser mockups (wrapping any other piece), dashboard, task cards that fly to avatars or tick off, bar/line/donut charts, counters, progress bars, notifications, checklist, chat, avatars, images, pricing cards, quotes, logo walls, calendars, maps, before/after sliders, forms and store buttons, with a moving and clicking cursor and designed transitions (wipe, push, zoom-through, mask-reveal, circle-reveal). The sentence stays as the headline.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz pieces [KIND | check REQUEST.json]; request field sceneVisuals:[{match,piece}]
tools.whenToUse: Every new video: give every scene a piece that shows what its sentence says.

tools.description: Create, resume, revise and approve a video job from a request manifest.
tools.whenToUse: Main production path for every new video.

tools.description: Low-level: create a project from a script.
tools.whenToUse: Debugging or scripted batch work.

tools.description: Low-level: plan scenes for a project.
tools.whenToUse: Debugging timing.

tools.description: Render a low-resolution preview and contact sheet.
tools.whenToUse: Before every final render.

tools.description: Render the final video from project.json.
tools.whenToUse: Prefer video:create; use directly only for debugging.

tools.description: Export a rendered project to mp2/.
tools.whenToUse: Delivery.

tools.description: Create a separate revision of a project.
tools.whenToUse: When the user asks for changes after a render.

tools.description: Replace or inspect a project script without changing other settings.
tools.whenToUse: Script fixes.

tools.description: Import media into a project.
tools.whenToUse: Adding footage, images or audio.

tools.description: List projects.
tools.whenToUse: Finding earlier work.

tools.description: Show a project manifest.
tools.whenToUse: Inspecting a job.

tools.description: Validate a project manifest.
tools.whenToUse: After manual manifest edits.

tools.description: Clean temporary files of a project (never exports).
tools.whenToUse: After delivery, for scratch files only.

tools.description: Automated frame checks: safe areas, overlaps, contrast, dead motion.
tools.whenToUse: Every script explainer, and before approval.

tools.description: Editorial critic scoring; revise anything below 4/5.
tools.whenToUse: Before the final render of explainers.

tools.description: Detect repeated layouts or themes across recent videos.
tools.whenToUse: When designing concepts, to keep each video distinct.

tools.description: Render benchmark.
tools.whenToUse: Performance work.

tools.description: Profile rendering of a project.
tools.whenToUse: Slow renders.

tools.description: Bind reviewed word timings to a voice-over.
tools.whenToUse: Narrated videos that need exact sync.

tools.description: Local acoustic analysis and Sorani alignment candidates (never auto-reviewed).
tools.whenToUse: Sorani narration when the user approved local analysis.

tools.description: Correct alignment candidates.
tools.whenToUse: Reviewing word cues.

tools.description: Apply reviewed cues to a project.
tools.whenToUse: After review.

tools.description: Search, assess, check, style-match and find similar assets in the library.
tools.whenToUse: Before sourcing or generating any new asset.

tools.description: List fonts or recommend fonts that cover a script for a style role, within the language policy.
tools.whenToUse: Choosing typography for every video.

tools.description: Rebuild the sound effect index with license evidence.
tools.whenToUse: After adding sounds.

tools.description: Download or import a sound with verified license evidence.
tools.whenToUse: When no suitable licensed local sound exists.

tools.description: Index reference media and styles.
tools.whenToUse: After adding references.

tools.description: Search references by words and category.
tools.whenToUse: Finding a style or motion example.

tools.description: Show a reference record.
tools.whenToUse: Studying a reference.

tools.description: Cut a short study clip from a reference video.
tools.whenToUse: Reference-match mode with video references.

tools.description: Attach a review to a reference.
tools.whenToUse: After studying a reference.

tools.description: Reference motion production tools.
tools.whenToUse: Layered recreations of a reference.

tools.description: The knowledge database (SQLite, committed as agent/brain/*.jsonl): curated motion design and video editing principles, styles, techniques, recipes, platform facts and things to avoid, plus the user's reference styles, guides, feedback rules and every finished job. Recall ranks by match and proven success; verdicts score what a job used; web findings stay trial until two approved jobs prove them.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz brain recall "BRIEF" | study "TOPIC" | add ... | learn-reference FILES --name N | apply --job JOB IDS | verdict JOB approved|revised|rejected | report
tools.whenToUse: recall at intake of every video and edit; study for new genres or when asked; learn-reference for every user reference; apply after building; verdict after the user's answer; report to show progress.

tools.description: Record the user's feedback on a video at once (their words to agent/knowledge/feedback.jsonl, a rule for next time to memory.md, merged and counted with the same point), and load the rules that apply to a new brief.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz feedback add "WORDS" --rule "RULE" --verdict reject|revise|approve [--job JOB] | lessons --for "BRIEF" | list | forget ID
tools.whenToUse: add: whenever the user rejects, corrects or praises something, without asking. lessons: at intake of every video.

tools.description: Search the motion and editing knowledge base.
tools.whenToUse: Planning any design or edit.

tools.description: Write a proposed knowledge update for the user to approve.
tools.whenToUse: After a verified, reusable lesson.

tools.description: Keep a time range of a clip.
tools.whenToUse: Remove a dead start or end.

tools.description: Split a clip into parts at given times.
tools.whenToUse: Rearranging or removing a middle section.

tools.description: Remove time ranges and close the gaps (ripple delete).
tools.whenToUse: Removing pauses, mistakes and filler.

tools.description: Join clips in order.
tools.whenToUse: Assembling an edit from several takes.

tools.description: Crop to a rectangle.
tools.whenToUse: Removing borders or reframing a region.

tools.description: Change aspect ratio around a focus point (for example 16:9 to 9:16).
tools.whenToUse: Platform conversion of footage.

tools.description: Static or animated zoom (punch-in) over a time range.
tools.whenToUse: Emphasis and hiding jump cuts.

tools.description: Change playback speed with pitch-preserved audio.
tools.whenToUse: Speed-ups, slow motion.

tools.description: Fade video and audio in or out.
tools.whenToUse: Starts, ends and soft transitions.

tools.description: Change gain over the whole clip.
tools.whenToUse: Balancing audio.

tools.description: Normalize loudness to a LUFS target.
tools.whenToUse: Every delivery with speech.

tools.description: Resize, with padding to keep aspect if needed.
tools.whenToUse: Matching a target resolution.

tools.description: Burn in captions from SRT or cues, right-to-left aware, with project fonts.
tools.whenToUse: Talking heads and narrated videos.

tools.description: Encode with a preset (social, web, archive, draft).
tools.whenToUse: Every delivery.

tools.description: Frame interpolation for smoother motion.
tools.whenToUse: Converting low-fps footage.

tools.description: Install the optional media tools (auto-editor, PySceneDetect, librosa, MediaPipe, rembg) into the project .venv.
tools.whenToUse: Once per machine, before the first media command. Ask the user first: about 300 MB of packages.

tools.description: Show which media tools and models are installed, and whether Demucs can use the GPU.
tools.whenToUse: When a media command fails or before planning work that needs it.

tools.description: One master exported to other shapes (9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:5): narrower shapes crop around a focus point (the face from media reframe), wider ones fit the whole frame over a blurred copy so nothing is cut off. Also automatic with formats in a video request.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media formats FILE --to 1:1,16:9 [--mode auto|crop|fit] [--focus-x X] [--background blur|#HEX]
tools.whenToUse: Deliver stage when the video goes to more than one platform.

tools.description: Cover image: picks the sharpest, best-exposed settled frame (or --at), adds a title in the language's font with the last word in the brand accent and the brand logo; PNG and JPEG. Also automatic with thumbnail in a video request.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media thumbnail FILE [--title TEXT] [--at SECONDS] [--size 16:9|9:16|1:1]
tools.whenToUse: Deliver stage of every video posted to YouTube, TikTok or Reels.

tools.description: ElevenLabs text to speech with word timings from its character alignment; writes the MP3 and a provider word alignment that video:create accepts (voiceover + wordAlignment). Cached by text, voice and settings.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media voiceover --file SCRIPT.txt --voice VOICE_ID | media voices
tools.whenToUse: Only when the user asks for a voice-over and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set.

tools.description: Background music under footage, lowered automatically while someone speaks (sidechain ducking) and back up in the gaps; gain, fades, loop, start and offset.
tools.whenToUse: Footage edits with music; follow with loudness.

tools.description: Read a product's website for its name, description, logo candidates, theme colour, ranked CSS colours and fonts (including Google Fonts); --download saves logo files and the scan to workspace/research/<site>/.
tools.whenToUse: Research stage of any promo or product video: run it on the official site, then confirm the logo and colours by eye. The user's own files win over the scan.

tools.description: Turn reference videos and images into a style brief: palette with background, text and accent roles, contrast, cut rhythm, motion energy, motion bursts and their easing, plus saved frames. Fonts and design intent are left for the agent to fill in by eye. With --save it becomes a reusable style in references/styles and references/catalog.json: up to six frames kept, videos turned into one motion sheet.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media style FILE... [--name NAME] [--save]
tools.whenToUse: First step of reference match: run it on every reference, look at the saved frames, complete the brief, then map the colour roles onto the user's brand.

tools.description: Detect shots and hard cuts (PySceneDetect) and summarize the editing rhythm: shot lengths and cuts per minute.
tools.whenToUse: Study a reference video's pacing before matching it, or split the user's footage into shots.

tools.description: Tempo, beat times, estimated bar starts and onsets of music (librosa). Video files are read through FFmpeg.
tools.whenToUse: Place cuts, entrances and punch-ins on the beat when a video has music.

tools.description: Remove image backgrounds (rembg with BiRefNet) and write new transparent PNGs with the subject box.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media cutout IMAGE... --out-dir DIR
tools.whenToUse: Isolate a product, person or object for a layered scene. Ask before --allow-download (birefnet-general-lite is about 225 MB). Check edges before use.

tools.description: Measure sharpness, exposure, contrast, clipping and noise of a video or image (OpenCV) and flag blurry, dark, bright or noisy frames.
tools.whenToUse: Check the user's footage before planning an edit, pick the best take, or check a rendered video or cut-out.

tools.description: Fail a rendered video that has stretches with no movement (over 1.5 s) or plain text-on-background frames (over 1 s); reports moving share and motion starts per second.
tools.whenToUse: On every motion video before delivery (mandatory, agent/policies.md). Fix every reported span, re-render and run it again.

tools.description: Measure camera pans, zoom and shake frame to frame (OpenCV optical flow), per second.
tools.whenToUse: Decide whether footage needs stabilizing, or study a reference's camera movement before matching it.

tools.description: Render a Lottie (Bodymovin JSON) animation frame by frame with lottie-web: transparent ProRes .mov, VP9 .webm or PNG frames, or .mp4 on a colour. lottie-info reports size, length and features.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media lottie FILE.json [--format mov|webm|png|mp4]
tools.whenToUse: Use an animated icon, sticker or lower third the user supplies (or a licensed one). Then place it with the editor overlay operation. Check its license first.

tools.description: Word-timed transcript of a video or audio file with ElevenLabs Scribe (English, Kurdish as kur, Arabic, Persian and more), cached by audio hash so a recording is never sent twice.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media transcribe FILE [--language L] [--diarize] [--keyterm WORD]
tools.whenToUse: Footage with speech, before captions or tightening. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in .env; the audio is uploaded to ElevenLabs, so tell the user the first time. Kurdish accuracy is moderate: anchor to the script when there is one.

tools.description: SRT captions from speech: readable cues of up to two balanced lines, split at sentences and pauses. With --script the caption text is exactly the user's script and only the timing comes from the recognised words.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media captions FILE [--script SCRIPT.txt] [--language L]
tools.whenToUse: Captions for footage or a voice-over in English or Kurdish. Prefer --script whenever the user has the script. Burn in with the editor captions operation.

tools.description: Remove pauses, filler words (um, uh; Kurdish ئە، ئەم...) and dead air from a word-timed transcript, keeping natural breaths, and retime captions to the edit. Without a transcript, media silence finds silent ranges by loudness.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media tighten FILE [--captions] [--script SCRIPT.txt] [--brand]
tools.whenToUse: The main talking-head edit. Review the listed cuts with the user, then run pnpm dimensaz edit --edl on the written edit list. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; otherwise use media silence.

tools.description: Color correction and LUT-based grading.
tools.whenToUse: Not available yet: say so and offer the closest ready tool.

tools.description: Stabilize shaky footage with OpenCV: smooth the camera path, zoom slightly to hide edges, keep the audio. Writes a new file.
tools.whenToUse: Handheld footage that media motion reports as shaky. Stabilize before other edits, then edit the stabilized copy.

tools.description: Place an image or video over footage (logos, lower thirds, Lottie clips, stickers) with position, width, timing, opacity and looping. Transparent .mov, .webm and .png keep their transparency.
tools.whenToUse: Adding a logo, a lower third or an animated element to the user's footage. Render Lottie files first with media lottie.

tools.description: Brand layer from config/brand.json: logo watermark in a chosen corner and an animated end card (logo springs in, call to action slides up, background drifts).
tools.whenToUse: Every branded footage edit unless the user says no. Put it last in the edit list, after cuts and captions.

tools.description: Transitions between clips (crossfade, push, zoom-through).
tools.whenToUse: Not available yet: say so and offer the closest ready tool.

tools.description: Insert b-roll or motion graphics over footage.
tools.whenToUse: Not available yet: say so and offer the closest ready tool.

tools.description: Separate the voice from music, noise and room sound with Demucs, giving a clean vocals track (and the music without voice).
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media separate FILE [--stems vocals|all]
tools.whenToUse: A noisy voice-over, speech over music, or a track the user wants without vocals. Ask before --allow-download (htdemucs is about 80 MB). Listen to the result before using it.

tools.description: Find where the speaker's face is (MediaPipe) and write a reframe operation that keeps them in a 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 crop.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz media reframe FILE --aspect 9:16 --edl-out EDIT.json
tools.whenToUse: Turning horizontal footage vertical. If the result says the speaker moves a lot, split by shots with media scenes and reframe each shot. Ask before --allow-download (0.2 MB model).

tools.description: Report the agent state for the mascot viewer.
tools.whenToUse: At every phase change outside video:create.

tools.description: Search free, license-clear assets: 3D models, textures and HDRIs (Poly Haven), icons (Iconify), images (Openverse, Pexels, Pixabay), stock video (Pexels, Pixabay), sounds (Freesound, Openverse) and music (Openverse). Shows only items allowed in final videos unless --all.
tools.whenToUse: Prepare stage, for every asset the production design needs that the user and the library do not have.

tools.description: Download items from the last search into workspace/downloads/<kind>/ with a source.json license record; refuses non-commercial, no-derivatives and unknown licenses.
tools.whenToUse: After looking at the search previews and choosing.

tools.description: Render a glTF/GLB model to transparent PNG views and an optional transparent turntable video with three.js, auto-framed with neutral studio light.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz source render-3d FILE.gltf [--views front,three-quarter,side] [--turntable SECONDS] [--color #HEX]
tools.whenToUse: To use a downloaded 3D model in a scene as a hero object or a rotating product shot.

tools.description: Reference video with yt-dlp: info only by default, --confirm downloads it (at most 1080p, optionally a --section). Always study only.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz source reference URL [--confirm] [--section START-END]
tools.whenToUse: Research stage, to measure a reference's pacing, cuts and motion with media style or media scenes. Ask the user before --confirm.

tools.description: Attribution lines for downloaded items that need them, for the video description or end credits; list shows every download with its license.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz source credits | source list
tools.whenToUse: Deliver stage of every video that used downloaded assets.

tools.description: Shows which provider keys are set, whether yt-dlp is installed, and runs one live search per provider.
tools.whenToUse: Once after setup, or when a source search fails.

tools.description: Read-only access to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Dribbble, Behance, Threads, Vimeo, Reddit, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Product Hunt, Google and GitHub through Agent Reach's design (OpenCLI, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, Exa): ordered backends with fallback, one JSON result shape with error codes, pacing and rate-limit pauses.
tools.whenToUse: Research stage: the brand's social accounts, trending examples of the genre, competitor videos, transcripts and comments.

tools.description: Read any link: picks the right channel and action by itself (video, profile, thread, pin, post, page), falling back to the page text.
tools.whenToUse: Whenever the user or research gives a link.

tools.description: Reference video from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Vimeo and most sites: info first, download with --confirm, using the Dimensaz browser's login for that site only; always study only.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz reach download URL [--confirm] [--section START-END]
tools.whenToUse: To measure a reference's pacing and motion with media style or media scenes, after the user agrees.

tools.description: Set up and manage Reach: add/remove channels, logins (the user logs in in a window, or the site's login is copied from their Chrome), doctor, live checks, update, uninstall.
tools.whenToUse: Once at setup, on NEED_LOGIN, or when a channel fails.

tools.description: Drive the Dimensaz browser (OpenCLI browser commands): open any page with saved logins, read its state, extract markdown, scroll, find, click or type to navigate, and take screenshots to workspace/research/screenshots.
tools.command: pnpm dimensaz browse open URL | state | extract | screenshot | scroll | click N | type N TEXT
tools.whenToUse: For pages the reach channels cannot read, and for screenshots of a brand's site. Never submit, post or buy without asking.

tools.description: List this registry.
tools.whenToUse: When unsure which tool fits.
